headline: Your wallet. Your rules.
summary: CopyPump is a non-custodial Solana automation project focused on bounded authority, deterministic risk controls and traceable execution. Mainnet remains intentionally blocked while the technical alpha is validated.

gates.label: Website
gates.detail: Public product, architecture and evidence surface

gates.label: Policy + risk
gates.detail: Deterministic capital, slippage, exposure and permission controls

gates.label: Audit evidence
gates.detail: Decision, execution, reconciliation and accounting trace

gates.label: Devnet lifecycle
gates.detail: BUY → partial sell → full sell with failure-path validation

gates.label: Mainnet access
gates.detail: Blocked until required validation gates pass

roadmap.label: NOW
roadmap.title: Full Devnet lifecycle
roadmap.copy: BUY → POSITION → PARTIAL SELL → FULL SELL. Confirm transactions, reconcile state, account for fees and review the execution record.

roadmap.label: HARDENING
roadmap.title: Safety under failure
roadmap.copy: Repeated requests, revoked permissions, emergency stops and recovery. Close the required engineering safety gates.

roadmap.label: PUBLISH
roadmap.title: Reviewable technical evidence
roadmap.copy: Publish evidence, selected tests and source after security, privacy and licensing review.

roadmap.label: AFTER THE GATES
roadmap.title: Limited production preparation
roadmap.copy: Evaluate readiness for tightly constrained Mainnet operation. This is a conditional next step, not an access or launch-date promise.
